def.label: 105 mm HE
def.note: Doc 16 fixes no ammunition number, so these are cut C's. 120 damage is chosen against the line_tank's own armour: it takes four rounds through the 400 cm front hull facet and one more through its 200 internals, three through a 250 side, and two through the 150 rear. 40 rounds is a real tank's ready plus stowed load and gives a match of about four minutes of aimed fire at a 6,000 ms cycle.
